title: Custom jerseys for 7-a-side & Sunday league
meta_descript: Custom kits for 7-a-side and Sunday league teams: your crest, sponsor, names and numbers, any mix of sizes. No minimum order, from €21.90.
content:
Quick answer

For 7-a-side and Sunday league teams, MOMUTO makes custom kits with your colours, crest, names and numbers, in polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

A real kit for a small-sided team

You don’t need a 20-player squad to look the part. A 7-a-side or Sunday league side can have a proper kit — crest, sponsor, names and numbers — starting from the free 3D configurator or a custom design.

No minimum order, mixed sizes

Order exactly the number of jerseys you need, in any mix of sizes from kids’ XS to adult 4XL. The per-jersey price still drops with quantity. Size guide.

Turn a casual team into a club

A shared kit is what turns a group of mates into a team. Add a sponsor from a local pub or business to cover the cost — see funding your kits.

Frequently asked questions

What’s the minimum for a Sunday league team?

There is no minimum. Order from a single jersey up to the whole team; the per-jersey price drops with quantity.

Can everyone pick their own size?

Yes — any mix of sizes from kids’ XS to adult 4XL in the same order, at no extra cost.

How long before our first match?

Allow 25–30 days from order to delivery, plus a day or two to validate the design.
